rights_basis: Faithful bounded reading transcription of original-language liturgical text from Stowe Missal (Warner 1915 Vol. 2): complete strict Canon Missae constituent, whose United States copyright term has expired by publication date (1915 critical edition (mediating Stowe core copied ca. 792, catalogue bounds 780-820, with undated Moelcaich revisions)). Derived directly from tracked public-domain facsimile artifact.catholic-church.stowe-missal.warner-1915-vol-2.ia-scan-27c6070e without modern translation or editorial reconstruction. Third-party historical text is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0 license.
text:
communicantes :
In natale domini
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes in quo incontaminata uirginitás huic mundo edidit saluatorem :
Kalendis
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes circumcisionis domini nóstri iesu christi :
stellae
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes natalis calicis domini nostri iesu christi ..
pasca
Et noctem uel diem sacratisimam ressurrectionis domini nóstri iesu christi :
In clausula pasca
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes clausulae pascae domini nóstri iesu christi ..
Ascensio
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes ascensionis domini nóstri iesu christi ad caelum :
pentacostén
Et diem sacratisimam celebrantes quinquagensimae domini nostri iesu christi in qua spiritus sanctus super apostolos discendit
Et memoriam uenerantes in primís gloriosae semper uirginis mariae genetricis dei et domini nostri iesu christi
Sed et beatorum apostolorum ac martirum tuorum Petri et pauli anriae iacobi iohannis thomae iacobi pilippi bartholomái mathei simonis et thathei lini ancleti clementis xisti corníli cipriani laurenti crisogini iohannis et pauli cosme et domiani et omnium sanctorum tuorum quorum meritís precibusque concedas ut in omnibus protectionis tuae muniamur auxilio . per :
